name: game-network
description: Step A0 of docs/design/game-reconstruction-and-motion.md: what Ocarina of Time's own anti-aliasing network costs on this GPU with each existing way of running its tensor instructions. Every variant runs the network (anti-aliasing Game, game presets off, frame generation off): software (the default on Intel), the shared-memory software gather (EDEN_NX2_SW_MATRIX_SHARED) and Intel's 8x16x16 cooperative matrices (EDEN_NX2_INTEL_COOP_MATRIX, a no-op on other GPUs), each against the software baseline, plus No sharpening, which replaces the network's output pass with a copy, as the floor. The network's cost is the output pass's GPU time in each row's gpu_costs (work, shader 6bd913e1f34e83eb with Max Resolution on). A row counts only when its log has no 'anti-aliasing network bypassed' line, except the no-sharpening row, which must have one. Keep the Max Resolution add-on as it is for every row; run the suite twice in one session and compare the two software rows before reading any difference.
